blockingFindings.description: Direct V216 crouch and sit renders show both trouser thighs exposed from hip toward knee; the apron folds below and beside the knees instead of spanning the lap. The standing front edge is continuous across both thighs, but the seated hem fails lap coverage.
Both V216 standing profiles show the lower apron bending forward into a projecting flap. The prone render has a second lilac-edged lobe below the main hem, leaving a doubled outline.
